latest.notes:
Fixes 'Fill Missing Attributes…' on a real library.

It used to fill only what was selected — and right-clicking a song selects just that one row, so it would report '1 song selected' and fill one song. It now offers the whole library or your selection, with both counts on a control at the top, and starts on the whole library unless you deliberately picked several songs.

It also used to write nothing until the entire run finished, so stopping it or closing the sheet threw away everything it had found. Results are now saved as it goes. A stopped run keeps its work, and running it again picks up where it left off — it only ever fills blanks, so re-running is always safe.
